verdict.rationale: Raygun documents its own Crash Reporting export, covering all or selected error groups or all data within a time range. CSV exports exist for filtered views, and an OpenAPI-documented v3 API lets you pull your Raygun data into other tools. However, the evidence never states the crash-export file format or shows a whole-account export across all products, and leaving is not covered. Missing for 10: documented open format for the crash-reporting export, export coverage across all products (RUM, APM, deployments), account deletion/offboarding documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The Raygun Crash Reporting export feature allows customers to export all error groups or selected errors groups from within the Crash Reporting dashboard.
You can also select to export all data within a specific time range.
Aligned **CSV exports** with applied top-level filters.
allows you to access your Raygun data so that you can display, manipulate and process it in other tools, scripts and applications.
